metric_definitions.stop_match_mode: 1 if the recommended stop count equals the most common stop count of the top ten
metric_definitions.stop_abs_err_median: |recommended stops - median stops of the top ten|
metric_definitions.w1_median_car: Wasserstein-1 distance (laps) between the tyre-age distribution of the recommended plan and that of each top-ten car's plan; the median over cars
metric_definitions.w1_nearest_car: the same, minimum over cars: is there a car that ran something like it
metric_definitions.longest_err: |longest recommended stint - median longest stint of the top ten| (laps)
metric_definitions.on_boundary: 1 if the shortest recommended stint is within one lap of the five-lap minimum
metric_definitions.usage_tv_median_car: total-variation distance between compound-usage shares (labels), median over cars

baselines.lap_rule: 2 stops if race_laps >= T else 1, T fitted on the OTHER races, equal stints
baselines.prev_season: the stop count the field modally ran at the same circuit the previous season, equal stints

rate_sources.in_sample: the race's own cell rates (NOT out of sample)
rate_sources.product_in_sample: the product's mixed-effects per-circuit rate, gated, practice fallback (NOT out of sample)
rate_sources.race_pooled: median race rate per compound over the other races
rate_sources.practice_scalar: this weekend's practice x factor learned on the other weekends
rate_sources.practice_label: the same with a factor per HARD/MEDIUM/SOFT label
rate_sources.practice_raw: this weekend's practice rate, no race correction (management-free wear)
rate_sources.blend: inverse-variance combination of practice_label and race_pooled
rate_sources.mixed_loeo: the product's mixed model refitted without the scored race (2026 only)

planner_variants.plugin: minimise total time on the point rates, stints bounded only by the five-lap minimum
planner_variants.robust: minimise expected total time with each rate replaced by its mean truncated at zero
planner_variants.+cap: plus a ceiling on each compound's stint: the 95th percentile of stints the field ran on that label in other races

out_of_time.headline: pit loss, lap-rule threshold and stint bounds are built only from races run BEFORE the one scored (the first races have no bounds: fewer than 30 earlier stints of a label). prev_season was already earlier-only.
out_of_time.still_leave_one_race_out: the degradation-rate sources (race_pooled, the practice factors, the mixed model refit) use the other races on either side of the scored one

leave_one_race_out_sensitivity.note: the same evaluation with pit loss, lap rule and stint bounds fitted on every OTHER race, including later ones (the form this module reported before it was made out-of-time)

adoption_rule_applied.rule: adopt if, for every rate source, stop-count agreement is not significantly worse (the paired 95% interval includes zero or the change is non-negative) and the mean age-distance falls
adoption_rule_applied.honest_note: On the product's own 2026 path (10 races) the point estimate of stop-count agreement FELL (see product_in_sample): the interval includes zero, and on the 2022-25 sources agreement is flat or higher, but it is a fall that ten races cannot rule out.

shipped_claim_rechecked.definition: median stop count of every 2026 car that stopped at least once

race_length_rule_best_threshold_fitted_o.caveat: threshold chosen on the scored events: an upper bound for the rule

pace_step_estimation.sign: positive = softer is FASTER by that many seconds

verdict.reading: The pace step is NOT estimated. The race estimators are tight but disagree in sign between 2026 and 2022-25 and neither is near 0.6; the practice estimators contain 0.6 but their intervals are too wide to exclude 0 (2026) or span 0.3-1.2 s (2022-25). It stays an assumption, and the sensitivity sweep is the honest way to read every plan that depends on it.
